order: The fourth review already found that citing a commit span collectively left a reviewer unable to tell which line came from which fix, so this fifth review for the round four fixes anchors to the pair bounding round three and round four, cited as that exact pair rather than a single joined citation, never collapsed into one span, a rule that now carries forward to every review after this one. Write the pinning order and the executor's write-up together. Both land as new files, and nothing outside them is touched. Keep the audit itself strictly to only what changed across that bounding pair, setting aside the longer history behind it entirely. Set down, without hedging, that an unhedged verdict here, and nothing short of it, is what lets the orders held in revise move forward.
